changes.text: Fixed a bug causing players to have no diminishing returns against creature stuns.
Fixed a bug causing players to have no diminishing returns when using stuns against creatures.
Fixed a bug incorrectly allowing Wild Growth to be cast while moving.
Wild Growth spell healing coefficient increased to 6.6% (was 3.3%).
Frost Nova is now correctly broken by damage from procs and damage from Blizzard.
Judgement of Command now activates on-hit effects and counts as a melee attack.

Developers’ notes: All other judgements will continue to be considered Ranged attacks. This matches Command’s uniqueness across the Judgements, where it was the only one considered a Melee attack. All other seals were considered Spells, but in WoW: Forever they are being considered Ranged attacks.
The Legacy Perk The Quick and the Dead will now correctly reduce the Mana cost of Divine Spirit.
Windfury Totem is now correctly activated by all melee abilities even if it doesn’t involve your main hand weapon.

path: Windfury Totem is now correctly activated by all melee abili
changes.text: Developers’ notes: Strikes from abilities that involve your offhand weapon like Whirlwind or Mutilate do not have a chance to activate Windfury. The main-hand strike from those abilities still does.
Siphon Life Rank 1 can no longer be cast while silenced.
Fixed an issue where Berserker Rage was not removing Sap.
Killing enemies in dungeons now awards zero experience to all party members if the level of the enemy is trivial to the level of one or more of the party members.
Sneed should now properly eject if the Sneed’s Shredder is stunned when reaching 0% health.
Non-boss enemies now respawn 2 hours after being killed (was 1 hour).
Defeating Balnazzar should now correctly count toward the Legacy Challenge Master Spelunker.
Gnomeregan - Techbot’s respawn time reduced for the quest “Save Techbot’s Brain!”
Badlands - Lesser Rock Elemental spawns should now appear more frequently.
Eastern Plaguelands - Fixed an issue that caused enemies to sometimes aggro unexpectedly in Stratholme and Eastern Plaguelands, particularly when resurrecting.
Mulgore - Quillboar spawning rates have been reduced in the starting area and should now be less aggressive.
Mulgore - Venture Co. spawn rates have been reduced in the starting area and should now be less aggressive.
Blasted Lands - Nethergarde Keep guards no longer drop loot and should have behavior consistent with other guards.
Stranglethorn Vale - Tiger, panther, and raptor spawns should now appear more frequently.
Zephras Isle - Nyalah Brightfire in Valanaar should now provide a more extensive array of cooking supplies for aspiring culinary artists.
Gloves of Holy Might now have the correct text description. Gloves of Holy Might is now only activated by spells and abilities that are harmful and deal damage.
The Glimmering Mithril Insignia trinket no longer requires the ability to wear Mail armor.
Fixed an issue where Cloak of the Fleshborer had no texture.
Taran Icebreaker now correctly behaves as a 2-handed Mace (was incorrectly behaving as a 1-handed Mace).
Darkspear signet rings have had their Mp5 corrected and now match Alliance-equivalent rings.
The Bad Hat no longer provides an incorrect amount of spell power.
Blessed Band of Light’s Hit stat has been removed.
Channeler’s Ring now has Spell Power (was Spirit).
Fixed an issue during the quest “The Talisman of Kazdor” where rogues would enter the wrong version of Zul’Farrak.
Deadwood Key, Drop of Stolen Life, Ring of the Fallen Soldier, Venom-dripping heart, and Blackthorne Intelligence should now drop for all players in the party who have the associated quest(s).
Pix Xizzix’s weekly dungeon quests are now properly removed from the quest log on weekly reset.
When you’re “Coyote Huntin’”, Sootfur’s pelt should now be shared for all members of your party.
The Crow Effigy should now be visible if you meet the quest requirements to interact with it on Mount Hyjal.
Unstable Package should no longer have a chance to proc while on a taxi during “Crate Expectations” and the misfire damage has been reduced.
Fixed a bug that caused a player picking up the quest “Return to the Port” to delete nearby players’ quest items for “The Cook in the Cage”.
Doomguard Xarkul kill credit should now be granted to healers who assist Yashiro on “Yashiro’s Windwalk”.
Riverglades - Resolved an issue with Jezap Jinglesprocket refusing to offer quests to players attempting the Bloodmaster’s Ring.
Feralas - Fixed several issues during the quest “Gordunni Cobalt.”
Riverglades - “Gaseous Gold” now denotes the correct amount required for the quest.
Riverglades woodpiles are no longer lootable when not on the associated quests.
Undercity and Stormwind - Fixed an issue where Owen Thadd and Garion Wendell would refuse to accept any books. Our outstanding library fees have been paid and we’re all back in good standing!
Fixed a bug that caused Action Bar settings to reset every time players who acquired Secondary Talents logged out of the game.
